scope.purpose: Read-only aggregate consistency, provenance, frozen-permalink, catalog-recount, and local-link gate.
scope.local_link_scope: Authored benchmark entry documents, milestone reports, and all 13 generated per-property reports selected by scope_globs.
scope.fenced_exact_quote_policy: Skip fenced exact-quote content while checking all authored links outside those fences.
scope.side_effect_policy: Validators known to rewrite saved reports are not invoked; their saved reports and owned artifacts are checked read-only.

validation: Standalone property JSON equals aggregate catalog object.
Property, AP, binding, and observation CSV/JSON projections agree.
Source file SHA-256, line range, and exact quote agree.
Runtime instances join exactly to Milestone-6 capture and parameter evidence.
All 10 active concrete instances carry Stage-7 coverage notes and no longer retain Stage-6 unvalidated wording.
PRE_FINAL permits no ACCEPTED status, implementation verdict, epsilon boundary, or closed review.
Recorded binding commit equals the frozen firmware commit.
Local source file exists and its bytes equal git show <commit>:<path>.
Recorded line and optional column are in range.
At least one checkable symbol token occurs in the nearby source window.
The exact reconstructed fixed-commit permalink occurs in binding evidence.
Macro spelling and expansion path:line locations are range-checked when present.
Static-manifest inputs, outputs, generator, validator, and documentation hashes agree.
Messages, fields, commands, seven command slots, configuration parameters, and time rows are recounted.
XML origin lines, configuration source locations, and time-row references resolve.
The four-profile runtime overlay remains separate from static catalog support and remains NOT_ASSESSED.

validated_target_forms: Absolute or relative path:line and path:start-end targets.

subvalidators.notes: Includes runtime capture, Stage-7 property catalog, and runtime overlay --check subvalidators.
Equivalent binding, source, schema, CSV/JSON, and provenance checks are performed read-only by validate_benchmark.py.
The saved PASS report is read; catalog artifacts are independently hashed and recounted.

limitations: This gate proves consistency and provenance, not firmware implementation satisfaction.
GitHub permalinks are reconstructed and checked against local frozen Git objects without network retrieval.
The local-link source scope excludes vendored documentation; fenced exact-quote content is skipped to avoid interpreting quoted source as authored Markdown.
Synthetic parser/monitor progress is not flight-controller trace evidence.

The superseded 14-candidate PX4 draft is retained only as a hash-fixed post-isolation archive; the aggregate gate excludes it from canonical inputs, while no externally anchored pre-move receipt exists to prove earlier historical identity.
unresolved: Twelve properties remain NEEDS_CONTEXT and one remains CANDIDATE.
Three atomic propositions remain PARTIALLY_BOUND; the additional PX4 data-link-loss AP preserves the unresolved normative liveness identity instead of inheriting the heartbeat implementation.
One synthetic monitor suite has an endpoint-verdict mismatch and one is unsupported under the primary runtime limit.
Hardware behavior, AP instrumentation fidelity, timestamp correlation, and implementation satisfaction remain unassessed.
No explicit FINAL_REVIEW_COMPLETE status file has been supplied.
